import Foundation.HigherHeatTerminalPolynomialIto

open OperatorDerivativeRewrite.Foundation
open HigherHeatPolynomialCylinders HigherHeatAnalyticCylinderDomain HigherHeatCompletedPairing
open HigherHeatWeakTimeAdjoint HigherHeatPairedDualCausality HigherHeatAllChannelNormalization
open HigherHeatPolynomialCurveAgreement HigherHeatPolynomialDualCurve HigherHeatDyadicTimeDensity

open scoped NNReal Topology BigOperators

noncomputable def reconstructed (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (N : ℕ) : Dual :=
  ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (2*m), N.choose (q+1) • channel m T q (powerField m hm T hT (N-(q+1)))

example (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (t : Interval) :
    coordinateCurve m hm T hT 0 t = pairing m hm T hT (core (1:Cylinder)) := by
  change powerFunction m T _ 0 t = _
  rw [powerFunction]

example (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (N : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    coordinateCurve m hm T hT N HigherHeatContinuousDualCoordinate.zeroTime = 0 := by
  change coordinateCurve m hm T hT N (node 0 (prefixNode 0 0 (Nat.zero_le _))) = 0
  rw [coordinate_curve_prefix, HigherHeatQuadraticItoData.prefix_zero,
    zero_pow hN, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]

example (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (N : ℕ) :
    coordinateCurve m hm T hT N ⟨1,zero_le_one,le_rfl⟩ =
      pairing m hm T hT (core (terminalCylinder^N)) := by
  have ht : node 0 (prefixNode 0 (size 0) le_rfl) = ⟨1,zero_le_one,le_rfl⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [HigherHeatQuadraticDualCurve.prefix_time]
    norm_num [size,HigherHeatDyadicLaws.gridSize,HigherHeatDyadicLaws.duration]
  rw [← ht, coordinate_curve_prefix, HigherHeatQuadraticItoData.prefix_end, map_pow]
  rfl

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) : reconstructed 3 (by decide) T hT 6 (core (1:Cylinder)) = 720*(T:ℝ) := by
  unfold reconstructed
  rw [← power_ito_channels]
  simp only [zero_pow (by decide : (6:ℕ) ≠ 0), sub_zero]
  rw [pairing_core_real, mul_one, terminal_moments]
  have h := PseudoPolynomialStein.moment_multiple 6 (by decide) (T:ℝ) 1
  norm_num at h ⊢
  nlinarith [h]

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.range (2*2), channel 2 T q
      (polynomialField 2 (by decide) T hT ((Polynomial.X:Polynomial ℝ)^5+(3:ℝ) • Polynomial.X^2) q))
        (core (terminalCylinder^3)) = 20160*(T:ℝ)^2 := by
  rw [← polynomial_ito]
  have he : Polynomial.aeval terminalCylinder ((Polynomial.X:Polynomial ℝ)^5+(3:ℝ) • Polynomial.X^2) -
      Polynomial.aeval (0:Cylinder) ((Polynomial.X:Polynomial ℝ)^5+(3:ℝ) • Polynomial.X^2) =
        terminalCylinder^5+(3:ℝ) • terminalCylinder^2 := by simp
  rw [he]
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, add_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [pairing_core_real, ← pow_add, terminal_moments,
    pairing_core_real, ← pow_add, terminal_moments]
  have h8 := PseudoPolynomialStein.moment_multiple 4 (by decide) (-(T:ℝ)) 2
  have h5 := PseudoPolynomialStein.moment_off_order 4 (by decide) (-(T:ℝ)) 5 (by decide)
  norm_num [neg_pow] at h8 h5 ⊢
  nlinarith [h8,h5]
